justification: No attacker-controlled data is processed and all memory operations are safe.
analysis: The function processes hash buckets from a hash table but does not validate any attacker-controlled inputs. The loop index 'i' is bounded by jhash_size(t->htable_bits) which is derived from the hash table configuration, not user input. No memory is read or written using attacker-influenced offsets or lengths. The function frees memory objects without any indication of use-after-free issues or null dereferences.
